own_solution.law: Snell's law and Fresnel p-polarised power reflectance R_p = [(n2 cos i - n1 cos t)/(n2 cos i + n1 cos t)]^2; transmitted power = (1 - R_p) P

notes: sin t = sin75/1.5 = 0.643951, cos t = 0.765067, cos i = 0.258819. r_p = (0.388229 - 0.765067)/(0.388229 + 0.765067) = -0.32675; R_p = 0.10677; T_p = 0.89323. P_t = 5 x 0.89323 = 4.466 mW; with 8.4 mW, 7.503 mW. Beam area cancels (intensity times area; transmittance is a power ratio), so C. 'Covers an area' (T6A28) could be read as the footprint on the surface rather than the cross-section; either way it cancels. Laser-pointer and earlier-run sentences are D.
